desc:
Discover the secrets that lie beneath your own apartment.

Will you succeed or perish?

Game inspired by Sally Face & Blocktales.
This is a SOLO project entirely made by Literal_Cow.

(GOOD PING IS RECOMMENDED FOR A SMOOTH GAMEPLAY & NO BUGS! <150ms)
BANNERS ART made by kyuukurarinz, Seiya, code, and Zoe

PC CONTROLS:
A/D - Move Left/Right
LShift - Run
Spacebar - Dash (ONLY IN COMBAT)
LClick - Attack (ONLY IN COMBAT & HAVE A WEAPON)
Q - Ability (ONLY IN COMBAT & HAVE A WEAPON THAT HAS ABILITY)
C - Activate the Polaroid (ONLY IN ACT 3 & HAVE A POLAROID)
X - Take a photo (ONLY IN ACT 3 & HAVE A POLAROID & ACTIVATED POLAROID)
